description: This file defines a functional interface named ReconnectListener, which specifies a callback method to be invoked when a connection to a service is re-established after being lost. It is part of the org.eclipse.hono.client package and is used to handle reconnection events in a Hono client context.

classes.name: ReconnectListener
classes.description: A functional interface for handling reconnect events when a connection to a Hono service is re-established.

methods.name: onReconnect
methods.description: Called when the client has successfully reconnected to the service. It receives the re-established client connection as a parameter.
